test: Power under worst-case load on the Anker Zolo 20K 45 W power bank (physical rig)

conditions.supply: Anker Zolo 20K 45 W power bank, USB-C PD to 15 V barrel cable, into the Jetson Orin Nano carrier
conditions.rover_battery: ON (motor supply, separate from the bank)
conditions.wheels: off the ground (confirmed by the captain)
conditions.attached: Uno over USB serial (CH340), iPhone over USB
load_for_200_s: farsight-llm (llama.cpp VLM, CUDA): back-to-back vision queries, 120-token answers
farsight-whisper (whisper.cpp, CUDA): back-to-back transcription of a 25 s speech clip
conditions.motors_for_180_s: both sides +255 / -255 alternating, 2 s on / 2 s off, M renewed at 10 Hz through rover/serial_test.Link with farsight.service stopped; any non-OK reply, timeout, or a dmesg under-voltage/brownout/over-current/USB-disconnect line would stop the run (M 0 0)
conditions.tools: tegrastats 500 ms, INA3221 hwmon 200 ms, dmesg --follow

results.kernel_log: only cpufreq DVFS notices during the run; no under-voltage, brownout, over-current, throttle, USB disconnect or reset
results.reboot: none (same boot id before and after)
results.after: farsight.service restarted; /health 200, Uno serial connected (rover true), max_pwm 255, min_pwm 70; farsight-llm, farsight-whisper, tailnet forward active

not_measured: Total power drawn from the bank: VDD_IN is the module input only; the carrier, fan and the USB-attached iPhone are outside it (read the Anker display)
Motor current: it is on the rover battery, not the bank
Sustained runtime and bank state of charge
Driving on the floor (wheels were in the air), camera streaming and YOLO inference in farsight.service during the motor pulses (the service was stopped to free the serial port)
raw_logs: kept on the Jetson in ~/power-test/bank-185550 (tegrastats, ina, dmesg, load, pulse)
